breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero by symmetry, but for a simply supported beam under a midspan point load the slope is zero at midspan, not at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies that the slope is zero at midspan (due to symmetry) and nonzero at the supports, computing θ_support = PL²/(16EI). It does not repeat the incorrect claim from the incomplete prompt that the slope vanishes at the supports. This aligns with the ground truth prompt which simply asks to compute both quantities without the erroneous symmetry assertion.
